svg.text: K8b Turning floor hub (T/S) and polar work
A closed pocket in the floor; magnets turn what sits on it. Puck X + hub angle reach every point of a Ø300 disc.
S: 1.5 Nm, 0–6000 rpm, inside the hollow T shaft
pocket Ø120 × 60, deep-drawn: no joint, no seal
T plug Ø110: 12 N42SH magnets in a welded can

g.text: board on its carrier; lugs into the plug

svg.text: wet above the pocket wall · all drives dry below it
B TOP VIEW: POLAR WORK ON T
T turns the work so the
1/3 Pizza: a rigid pin lies along a radius, the puck presses 30–40 N, T turns: the dough rolls out round (a potter’s jigger).
2/3 Toppings by polar placement: T turns the tray until the spot is on the tool line, the puck slides to that radius, drops.
3/3 S, the fast drive inside T: a jug sits over the thimble, its blade turns by magnets through the closed wall (0–6000 rpm).
